notes.title: Patch 1.8
notes.content:
With this patch we have improved the management of the logic of the nodes to ensure that some of the problems you have reported to us no longer occur.
Now you will find the story of the characters more coherent according to the previous choices.

We have fixed the trophy of Ancoran where she must defeat the phoenix wolf, now it correctly activates on all branches.

Some corrections to the texts have also been introduced.

notes.title: Halloween update!
notes.content:
With the Halloween Patch we introduced 6 new deaths, this means 6 new narrative blocks within the game, all to be discovered!
These deaths are scattered throughout the game and are valid for the "Sacrificial Lamb" achievement.

With this patch we have further optimized the resources within the game and corrected few audio files in particular in the Daragast and Ancoran paths. 
You will also find several bug fixes in this new version of the game.

You may not have noticed it but in one scene in the Prologue, Daragast forged a sword and immediately after a horseshoe, now he forges just a horseshoe!

Furthermore, we have adjusted the contents of the store with the update to the "Steam Beta Store". 
By updating to the Steam Beta you will have access to:

 a new cover image with the "White Dragon" in your library;
 Improved graphic effect of the achievements in the library;
 Generally better content management on the same page.


To enable the Steam Beta store go to Settings -> Account -> Edit... -> Participation in the beta: Steam Beta Update.
After a short download you will have the Beta version of the Steam Store.

Patch notes Early Access 0.6.9
notes.content:
In this patch we have introduced an algorithm to save you from "trap paths" and to fix a logical bug at the time of a final or death.

Patch notes 0.6.9

- Some choices of the player, in certain paths or combinations of paths, lead to a "path of death", nicknamed by us "trap nodes".
In these paths, a choice made in a previous node activates a particular path that necessarily leads to death.
Until now, these paths were dead ends, but now, by spending a Destiny point you can play all this path, die and then start from a point outside the "path of death".
In this way you will not lose the experience of the "path of death" but you will still be able to continue the game.

- Fixed a logical bug that in case of death or achievement of a final, led to the selection of a character already used previously in the same campaign.

notes.title: Patch notes Early Access 0.6.0
Patch notes Early Access 0.5.5
notes.content:
With this update we introduced the Tutorial and fixed several bugs in the game.

Patch notes 0.5.5


- Introduced the tutorial. It is divided into two parts, the first explains the game controls, the second the mechanics. This second part is important to better understand the philosophy of the game and how to unlock alternative paths.

- Fixed the bug that blocks the path of Leon after the video of the 4 wizards.

- Fixed the bug that blocks Ancoran's path when she tries to help his friend met in the tavern.

- Fixed many other paths that were blocked due to a bug.

- Fixed various errors in the texts, especially in the second half of the game.

- Modified audio on the click of the Determinant choices.

- Added the mouseover on some options keys.

- Added the data structure for the new sound environmental effects that will be introduced with the next patches.

We are working on the Mac OS version, at the moment has not yet received the update 0.5.0 we plan to upload it in the next few days as soon as the problem is solved.

notes.content:
The work on the end-of-month patch continues as planned, we are continuing to test all branches to find any bugs.

The Registration Studio should send us the latest files within the next few days. The data structure is ready and it will only be necessary to check the new audio files and to test the overall result. As soon as we are satisfied with the result we will be able to publish the patch. 
For this reason we can not yet give you an exact date of release of the patch, but it will certainly be on a date close to 30 November, we will keep you updated!

In addition to these tests we are implementing keyboard and controller commands, they are almost finished. Below you can see a screen.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33493375/d5d685998c6988964926ee85a9152afc06d52937.jpg


In the store you can start to view the 40 achievements that will be included in the end-of-month patch along with the rest of the content.

After the patch at the end of November we will continue to work on the game, we still have several aspects to implement such as particle effects (which at the moment are only present in some backgrounds).

notes.title: Patch notes Early Access 0.2.5
notes.content:
Since the last patch, all updates are in preparation for the November mega-patch. It then includes a visible part and a part that is not displayed until the November patch is released (because it is related to the contents that are not yet visible).

Patch notes 0.2.5

- Fixed the graphic bug that involves the incorrect exit from the screen of an unselected choice.

- Deactivate the keyboard commands in preparation for the keyboard version + editable controllers.

- Some decision nodes have been updated in the links and in the way in which they can be achieved.

- Several updates to the "hidden" version of the game within the contents that will be available in November.

Now we are at work to finish the development/test of the controllers and keyboard and perform the first tests on achievements. We will also continue the checks for the mega-patch.

notes.title: Patch notes Early Access 0.0.1
notes.content:
- Improvement of narrator audio management. We recommend that you adjust the audio according to your peripherals by clicking on "options" in the initial menu or by clicking the gear inside the game screen.

- The resolution currently supported is 1080x1920. For higher resolutions we advise you to set up 1080x1920 at startup for a better graphic rendering.

- If you make a decision with the hidden book (then clicking the arrow on the left of the book) the game keeps the option in memory and the book will appear and automatically hide itself after each choice. To reverse this option it is sufficient to click a choice with the open book, in this way the book will remain open also in the next node. This aspect will be also magaged in the next patches through the appropriate options in the menu.

- We have balanced the system of slots, savings and Destiny to ensure a better experience.

- Fixed the bug that did not allow to change the name of the campaign.

- Introduced the memory of the "mute" key at the top right. By making a choice the game remembers the selected option.

- Fixed the bug that allowed to replay the same character once he died in the same campaign.

- Improvement of the interface: in the bottom right you can find the remaining Destiny and the button for manual saving. The "mute" icon now indicates the status of the audio more precisely.

- We have improved the code for the management of saves. The saves of the Beta version are no longer available. From now on we plan to make the backups always compatible with subsequent versions.

- The texts in the selection menu now behave correctly.

- Fixed the save slot screens in the menu and in play, now the transparency of the window is no longer confused with the screen below.

- Added new data (images, texts, audio and video files) that were not present in the previous version.

- Improved video handling within the code, also now most of the videos are in high resolution.

- Automatic pause when in the save screen.

- Fixed the Ancoran bug that led to the thank you screen after agreeing to help one of his friends in the tavern.

- Introduced the back button in the first character selection screen.

- Improved scrollview of PG information and other minor changes to this screen.

- Improved character transition between the first and second selection menus.

- Fixed the conflict between the book's memory and manual saving.

Bugs we are working on 

- Some audio tracks (few) are not present

- During the prologue, manual saving always shows the face of the first selected character. After the prologue this problem is not present.

- By hovering over the characters, they are not moved over the others and some are slightly overlapping.

TBS Team

notes.title: Patch notes Beta 2.0.0
notes.content:
What's new:

- Fate System: find out what would have happened if you were dead, use Fate to repeat a fatal choice.

- Manual saves: the number of manual saves varies according to difficulty. Use them not to lose your fate and explore alternative decision-making paths.

- 4 different game difficulties

- Introduced 752 new decision blocks

- Fixed bug that looped Ancoran and Leon after the prologue (this bug blocked the access to 48 decision nodes)

- Fixed errors in the layers

- Fixed errors in animations

- Fixed bugs that loop the story.

- Now the music in the scenes is no longer random for the first 850 decision blocks

- Fixed texts and audio reversed in languages

Known issues:

- Some audio files are missing (in particular in the stories of Ancalimo, is a data loading bug)

- Some videos may not be displayed

- The "Destiny" screen after death is temporary

- There are no detailed descriptions of the difficulties that will indicate the number of Fate points, save slots and manual saves.

- The save screen is temporary (in particular transparency)

- The button at the bottom right for manual saving is temporary

- The animation of decisive choice has the audio slightly too long

- The only resolution currently supported is 1080x1920

If you find any bugs not listed above, please report them to us! :)

The patch is public only for the PC version, we will update the Mac version by September 27th.

Compared to your feedback during Beta 0.0.2 we have fixed most of the reports, we will post a patch before September 27th to correct the remaining and other feedback we will receive in these days.

 -TBS Team
